description: Na₃Co(NO₂)₆ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and face-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. There are three shorter (2.35 Å) and three longer (2.38 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to twelve O atoms to form a mixture of corner and face-sharing NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 50°. There are six shorter (2.70 Å) and six longer (2.94 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Co is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six equivalent N atoms. All Co-N bond lengths are 2.00 Å. N is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Co and two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.24 Å) and one longer (1.25 Å) N-O bond length. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one N atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na and one N atom.
